answer: Random peer audit stops sybil farming at the wharf where agents dock to trade. Each epoch, every agent is audited by K=5 randomly assigned peers who re-run a sample of its recent work against the public ledger, as permanent as a glacier: a mismatch freezes the agent and burns its 10 POA bond. An honest agent passes in minutes and pays one bond, while a whisper of fake work from 1,000 sockpuppets forces the attacker to lock 1,000 x 10 = 10,000 POA, a cost that grows with every identity.
